title: Finite family descent of pullback morphisms
statement: Let D be a directed inverse system of qcqs schemes with affine transition maps and c a limiting cone. Fix i, a finite family V_a and a target W, all finitely presented over D_i, and morphisms ψ_a from V_a ×_{D_i} c.pt to W respecting the structure maps. There is j ≥ i and morphisms ψj_a from V_a ×_{D_i} D_j to W respecting structure maps, whose compositions with the canonical limit-to-stage pullback maps equal ψ_a. The family can be empty.

proof.text: Apply exists_pullback_hom_of_isLimit separately to each member. Choose an upper bound of the finite range of resulting stages and i by Finite.bddAbove_range and exists_ge_ge. Compose each descended arrow with the canonical pullback map to its own stage. Pullback projection equations prove the structure-map equation; pullback.hom_ext and cone naturality identify the composite limit-to-stage maps, giving the required equality. For the empty family the finite range has an upper bound by nonemptiness; all equations are vacuous.

theorem finite_pullback_hom_descent
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ (i : Iᵒᵖ), CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i : Iᵒᵖ), QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i : I) (n : ℕ)
    (V : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) (W : Scheme.{u})
    (pV : ∀ a, V a ⟶ D.obj (op i)) (pW : W ⟶ D.obj (op i))
    [∀ a, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (pV a)] [∀ a, QuasiCompact (pV a)]
    [∀ a, QuasiSeparated (pV a)]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation pW] [QuasiCompact pW] [QuasiSeparated pW]
    (ψ : ∀ a, pullback (pV a) (c.π.app (op i)) ⟶ W)
    (hψ : ∀ a, ψ a ≫ pW = pullback.fst (pV a) (c.π.app (op i)) ≫ pV a) :
    ∃ (j : I) (h : i ≤ j)
      (ψj : ∀ a, pullback (pV a) (D.map (homOfLE h).op) ⟶ W),
      (∀ a, ψj a ≫ pW = pullback.fst (pV a) (D.map (homOfLE h).op) ≫ pV a) ∧
      ∀ a,
        pullback.map (pV a) (c.π.app (op i)) (pV a) (D.map (homOfLE h).op)
          (𝟙 _) (c.π.app (op j)) (𝟙 _) (by simp) (by simp) ≫ ψj a = ψ a
